scope.allowed_change: native UV-atlas registration, PixelLab-derived ageing textures, and material roughness only

geometry_and_layout.method: Opened both editable .blend files independently and compared every mesh's world-space vertex coordinates and polygon vertex-index topology.
geometry_and_layout.conclusion: No geometry or layout change was found between the frozen v1 source and v2.

native_uv_density.method: Imported the final GLB, used its material-specific image dimensions, and computed square-root(texel triangle area / world-space triangle area) for each effective AGE-material triangle.

excluded_degenerate_triangles.reason: collinear closed-flight fan residuals after GLB export; they have no renderable surface area and are not valid density samples

strict_positive_area_overlap.method: Per-atlas strict interior edge-crossing and point-containment test; shared triangle edges alone do not count as overlap.

edge_extrusion.method: Re-rasterized final UV islands, reproduced the specified two rounds of 4-neighbour nearest-valid dilation, and compared every expected padding texel against the delivered PNGs.

portable_editable_source.method: Opened the final editable Blend directly rather than relying on its supplied portability record.

generation_record_readback.route: Official PixelLab Creator / Edit Image Pro Flash in Chrome extension

source_and_workflow_lineage.placement_method_declared: fixed semantic contact masks plus PixelLab lower-edge samples only; no procedural ageing marks
source_and_workflow_lineage.script_readback: The build script selects named contact zones, samples the three raw PixelLab images, and packs them; it does not contain a random/noise/scratch/stain generator.
source_and_workflow_lineage.boundary: This verifies the retained local records and build behavior, not PixelLab's remote account history.

runtime_validation.parent_reported_visual_review: Parent reports final A/B coverage of grip, tread, platform, walls, turn, full view, hero/occupied and baseline states; this is not an independent runtime judgment by this validator.

not_tested: Running Godot or inspecting live interaction/lighting in this validation pass
Remote PixelLab account state beyond the saved generation record
overall: pass_file_side; final GLB BFAC1D... is geometrically unchanged from v1, has effective native 80 px/m UV density, no positive-area UV overlap or out-of-bounds coordinates, and verified two-pixel atlas extrusion. Runtime and aesthetic approval remain separate gates.
